thesis: Ionis's value now rests on whether its wholly owned launches can carry a $450 million operating loss to break-even before the cash runs short. DAWNZERA is on plan and royalties and partner payments are healthy, but TRYNGOLZA's sHTG launch, the largest opportunity, sold $9.3 million in its first full quarter after a list-price cut. The base case needs it at about $250 million by 2029 with flat expenses and is worth only today's price, so the expected return is slightly negative once the bear's dilution is counted.
consensus_view: No Street snapshot was captured. The stock fell 38% from $45.75 on September 22 to $28.19 on November 10, including 21% on the release day, so the market has repriced the TRYNGOLZA sHTG opportunity sharply lower. Management still describes multi-billion-dollar peak sales.
variant_view: The market's 38% fall rejects management's multi-billion TRYNGOLZA peak but still pays about 5.1x 2026 revenue. This call goes slightly further: the base case (13% a year to 2029, 78th percentile for the size, with flat expenses) is worth about today's price, and a bear that needs equity near $10 outweighs a 15% bull. Checkable: the 2027 TRYNGOLZA guide comes in below $150 million and the company does not date its path to positive cash flow.

Revised twice after independent review: both rounds graded B; the second-round corrections moved the rule rating from Watch to Avoid; see review.

low_score_reasons: valuation: The bear funds its gap with a $700M raise at about $20 a share yet values the stock at $8.58 in the same scenario; below a raise price of about $11.15 the weighted value falls under $28.19 and the rule says Avoid, so the rating depended on an input that contradicts its own scenario. The multiples are still not tested against peers or history.
variant_view: The note said it is 'a fairly priced call, not a disagreement' - honest, but no checkable view that differs from the market's.
risk: The cash kill criterion (below $1.2B at September 30, 2027) does not fire even on the call's own bear path (about $1,275M), so it cannot separate bear from base (about $1,350M).

calibration: The base sits at the 78th percentile and needs TRYNGOLZA at 5x after the guide miss; the 97th-percentile bull at 15% weight still supplies 37% of fair value, and without it the call is Avoid.
review.counter_case: Avoid. By the call's own math the base case is worth about today's price, and 37% of fair value comes from a 97th-percentile bull with a 15% weight. The bear raises $700M at $20 while valuing the stock at $8.58. At any raise price below about $11, fair value falls under $28.19 (at $10: bear $7.38, fair value $28.11, slightly negative a year). The base also needs cash use to fall from about $645M in 2026 to $400M in 2027 and zero in 2029, while partner R&D revenue drops from about $400M to $300M. The response accepted only the weight change and left that path untouched.
review.response: Accepted, and the stance changes to Avoid. The bear's $700M raise is now priced at about $10, near the bear value (70M shares, 247M total); the Royalty Pharma obligation uses the 21.6% effective rate seen in 2026, per scenario ($160M/$150M/$140M left at end-2029); the base case now has an explicit cash bridge (expenses held near the 2026 level of about $1,340M, loss $320M/$190M/$70M in 2027-2029, cash use $400M/$200M/$100M), which lowers base value to $29.21. Fair value is $27.69, -0.6% a year: Avoid by the rule, at the boundary (with a 20% bull it would be Watch). The kill criteria now name what would overturn the Avoid view (a 2027 TRYNGOLZA guide of $150M or more, a quarter above $30M, a positive REVEAL readout), and the cash test moved to $1.3B under change_my_mind. The WAINUA sentence no longer implies the 10-Q explains the royalty drop. Not changed: the multiples, for lack of a peer set.
